# gender value

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:genderValue`](gmeow-genderValue.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/genderValue>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/gender`](../../slices/gender.md)

The [`gmeow:Gender`](../classes/gmeow-Gender.md) value a gender-identity facet asserts (functional PER FACET — one value each; multiplicity is expressed by multiple facets). The value is a [`gmeow:Gender`](../classes/gmeow-Gender.md) individual: a predefined one, or — when none fits — a fresh individual carrying [rdfs:label](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#label) (the custom-PronounSet idiom). The single path to the gender value; there is deliberately no flat datatype shortcut.
